claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Prednisolone at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; glucocorticoid receptor agonism produces cytostatic or pro-apoptotic effects only in lymphoid-lineage lines at much higher concentrations, and no dominant off-target cytotoxicity is expected at this concentration.
